content:
Today was a long and productive day. Basketball practice went well, and I feel like I'm really starting to hit my stride on the court. It's always a great feeling to be able to do what I love and work towards my goal of making it to the NBA.

After practice, I had some time to relax and unwind at home. Playing video games is a great way for me to destress and take my mind off things. It's important to have some downtime, especially during the season when things can get pretty intense.

As I get ready to turn in for the night, I feel grateful for the opportunities I have and the support of my friends, family, and girlfriend. I know that I have a lot of hard work ahead of me, but I'm determined to optimize my performance and make the most of my time at Duke. Goodnight.
